user.title: Remote Comfort
user.description: Set up comfort control for a home. You'll add HVAC zones and rooms afterwards from the integration page.

data.name: Name
data.presence_sets_away: Use away targets when nobody is home

data_description.weather_entity: Used to pre-cool on hot days and start recovery earlier in extreme weather.
data_description.presence_entities: People, phones, or sensors. If anyone is home during a scheduled away period, comfort targets are kept.
data_description.presence_sets_away: Also switch to away targets on remote/off days when every presence entity says nobody is home.
data_description.respect_manual_changes: If someone changes a thermostat by hand, leave that zone alone until the next period (e.g. until bedtime).
data_description.wake_lead: How long before wake-up to start moving to daytime targets.
data_description.sleep_lead: How long before bedtime to start cooling/warming the bedrooms.
data_description.return_lead: Base time before you get home to start recovering. Extended automatically in extreme weather.
data_description.idle_zone_offset: How far to relax a zone whose rooms aren't in use right now (e.g. downstairs overnight).
data_description.compensation_limit: Maximum amount a zone's thermostat setpoint is biased so the rooms you care about reach the target.

schedule.title: Your week
schedule.description: Days that are neither remote nor office days are treated as days off.

comfort.title: Comfort targets
comfort.description: Prefer to sleep cold? Set the sleep cool and heat targets lower than daytime.

error.day_overlap: A day can't be both a remote day and an office day.

data.presence_sets_away: Use away targets when nobody is home

data_description.presence_sets_away: Also switch to away targets on remote/off days when every presence entity says nobody is home.
data_description.respect_manual_changes: If someone changes a thermostat by hand, leave that zone alone until the next period.
data_description.return_lead: Base time before you get home to start recovering. Extended automatically in extreme weather.
data_description.idle_zone_offset: How far to relax a zone whose rooms aren't in use right now.
data_description.compensation_limit: Maximum bias applied to a zone's setpoint so the rooms you care about reach the target.

data.hot_threshold: Hot day: forecast high at or above
data.cold_threshold: Cold day: forecast low at or below
data.hot_away_cap: Hot day: max away drift above comfort
data.cold_away_cap: Cold day: max away drop below comfort
data.lead_per_degree: Extra lead time per degree past the threshold

data_description.precool_offset: On hot days, while you're home in the morning, cool this much below the comfort target so the house coasts through the afternoon peak.
data_description.hot_away_cap: Keeps an empty house from heat-soaking on hot days so it can recover by the time you're back.

balancing.title: Zone balancing
balancing.description: Applies to zones that share an HVAC unit (zoned dampers). When one zone is much further from target than another, the comfortable zone is temporarily closed so all the air goes where it's needed.

data.balance_trigger: Start when the worst zone is off target by
data.balance_spread: ...and at least this much worse than the zone being closed
data.balance_safety: Re-open a closed zone if it drifts past target by
data.balance_cooldown_minutes: Wait before closing the same zone again

error.day_overlap: A day can't be both a remote day and an office day.

user.title: Add HVAC zone
user.description: One thermostat, or one zone thermostat on a zoning panel. Zones that share the same HVAC unit can be balanced against each other.

data_description.unit: Give zones served by the same furnace/air handler the same unit name (e.g. "Main unit").
data_description.compensate: Bias this thermostat's setpoint so the rooms in use reach the target, not just the thermostat's own location.

error.climate_in_use: That thermostat is already used by another zone.

user.title: Add room
user.description: Rooms decide which temperatures matter when. Bedrooms count overnight, offices and living spaces during remote work hours, and everything but bedrooms when you're home.

options.setback: Raise/lower its setpoint (safest with zoning panels)
